title: Juicy Vietnamese Ground Beef Banh Mi
description: A crowd-pleasing Vietnamese dish featuring ground beef and served in a banh mi, this recipe is a umami-rich and diabetic-friendly option, with a glassy-jelly texture from the pickled vegetables. It is made with agemono-deep-fry techniques for added crunch.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, cook the ground beef over medium-high heat until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the fish sauce and soy sauce to the skillet and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2 minutes, until the liquid has been absorbed.
In a small bowl, mix together the mayonnaise and sriracha.
Spread the mayonnaise mixture onto the toasted banh mi bread.
Top the bread with the cooked ground beef, pickled carrots, pickled daikon, cucumber, and cilantro.
For added crunch, deep-fry the cooked ground beef in hot oil at 350 degrees Fahrenheit for 2-3 minutes, until crispy.
Drain the deep-fried ground beef on paper towels before serving.
